entities.name: E. coli AidB (P33224)
observations: The supplied 541-aa sequence is an exact 100% match to reviewed UniProt P33224 (E. coli K-12) AidB.
AidB is part of adaptive response to alkylating agents; binds double-stranded DNA, with preference for a region including its promoter.
Shows weak isovaleryl-CoA dehydrogenase activity in vitro; FAD cofactor; annotated cytoplasmic homotetramer.
Sequence-derived: 60,589 Da; theoretical pI 7.98; Pfam AidB_N, Acyl-CoA dehydrogenase middle and C-terminal domains.
